verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair question for an agent collaboration platform like LobeHub, but the evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for event subscription. The public REST API, OpenAPI spec and SDK are inbound integration surfaces, and the Telegram/Slack/Discord messenger integrations are chat-app channels; neither counts as webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
